environment: Chromium 144 / SwiftShader under Xvfb, production logic with only resource URLs rebased to local blobs. Synthetic touch; not a physical iPhone or Safari.

results.name: Real textured skinned humans are loaded, without primitive fallback
One player, six free-for-all racers and nine local guards
Horizontal speed converts m/s into km/h
Ascent uses positive measured vertical velocity only
Distance is horizontal metres to the next landing centre
Descending activates descent and zeros ascent
Altitude is clearance above actual terrain
Grounded altitude correction does not create false ascent
W moves the player without firing
Space remains a real ground jump
Desktop input indicators are click-through, not blockers
Mix, chew and inflate launches using actual ingredients
Flight produces speed and ascent readings from simulated displacement
Additional gum mass physically causes faster descent
Balloon hits add mass and damage the membrane
Finite membrane expires; gravity then acts
A body cannot walk through a rendered outpost pillar
The same pillar stops projectiles before targets behind it
Actual gum projectile impacts increase opponent weight
Landing and collecting advances only the next checkpoint
Chests provide the next flight recipe
The same player cannot duplicate an already looted chest
Flying straight to the final plateau does not bypass checkpoints
A valid final landing finishes the race
Map renders terrain and the route, not an empty panel
FPS camera and gun viewmodel are active
Pause clears held controls safely
No document text selection/context action
Flight leg 1 can reach its landing plateau
Flight leg 2 can reach its landing plateau
Flight leg 3 can reach its landing plateau
Flight leg 4 can reach its landing plateau
No uncaught desktop runtime exceptions
Inner right aiming and left motion do not force shooting
Outer ring shoots while the independent left thumb keeps moving
Lifting the right thumb does not reset held left movement
Desktop key/mouse panels are absent from mobile
430x744 flight instruments and controls remain on-screen
430x932 flight instruments and controls remain on-screen
932x430 flight instruments and controls remain on-screen
375x667 flight instruments and controls remain on-screen
No uncaught mobile runtime exceptions
